newsitem.title: USA: Vastar sets $585 mln capital budget in '97.
newsitem.headline: Vastar sets $585 mln capital budget in '97.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said it plans capital expenditures of $585 million in 1997 as it begins a five-year $3.4 billion spending program.
The 1997 plan marks an $18 million increase over 1996 and emphasizes core operating areas in the offshore U.S. Gulf, Gulf Coast, San Juan Basin, and Mid-Continent region.

Vastar said it will spend approximately $200 million for exploration, with about 80 percent designated for offshore Gulf of Mexico where it plans to drill more than 20 wells. It also start- up of the company's deepwater drilling program during the second half of the year.
More than $265 million of the capital program is allocated for development of existing properties.
In addition, approximately $120 million has been designated for acquisitions and other opportunities.

In the five-year plan, Vastar said it anticipates that approximately 40 percent of the $3.4 billion will be devoted to exploration, 50 percent to exploitation and development, and 10 percent to acquisitions.
